$comment: Variables of the LumiBase service in the Railway template (#741). Railway templates are composed in Railway's template editor, not read from the repository; this file is the reviewed source a maintainer copies them from, and scripts/__tests__/deploy-manifests.test.mjs keeps it honest. Postgres and Redis are Railway's official database services named `Postgres` and `Redis`. Service source: Docker image ghcr.io/khuepm/lumibase-cms (pin a release tag). Enable a public domain on the service so RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN exists.
